description: On the table in front of you is a small black case, and inside are a few small items including a pale flower-like piece and several small containers. The left hand stays resting on the table while the right hand reaches forward to unlatch and lift open the case lid, then reaches inside to remove the pale flower-like piece and set it down on the table, followed by taking out a gray oval container and placing it in front; the right hand then removes small clear vials with white caps one by one and sets them upright on the table near the gray container.
